blurb: No Rainy Days offers luxury yacht rentals on Chicago's lakefront with several yacht options. Guests can rent yachts for a day on the water with family and friends. The company provides an easy online booking platform and offers approved captains for hire if needed.
extraNote: $500 deposit for incidentals, returned within 48 hours if no claims · Cleaning fee $125 if boat not cleaned; vomit cleanup fees $325 onboard, $150 overboard; other damages TBD · Cancellation notice required 14 days prior for partial refund; first hour prepayment non-refundable · Weather determined chartable or unchartable by operator; unchartable weather leads to reschedule credit valid for one year · 31st Street Harbor, downtown Chicago
